metadata.subject: motorbike
metadata.experiment_note: Motorbike on a route with cobblestone (sett) and asphalt segments. Stone-route and asphalt-route states include straight segments; exiting/returning to the car park and the U-turn maneuver are not straight. First half of the route (first stone + first asphalt) 60 km/h; second half (asphalt + stone after the U-turn) 60 km/h.
metadata.related_article: Witulska, J., & Wyłomańska, A. (2022). Identification of the structure break point for data with changing variance. Mathematica Applicanda, 50(1), 65-106. https://doi.org/10.14708/ma.v50i1.7155
